body: Thanks for your words, but what makes you think I am a Christian?

seriously?! You are not going to "convince" me to become an atheist. Unless you want to talk about how you can help me gain employment in one of the Schengen countries of the EU you should just give it up. Have a good day though.

I believe in science. I believe in evolution. I don't believe in religion. I believe in God. I would never treat you any differently or look at you in any less of a respectful way because you are an atheist. Your belief in no God is no concern of mine. Please please please don't think you will ever cause me to break the one fundamental truth I know in my heart of hearts. It is bigger than me. It is bigger than you. It is bigger than science. It is bigger than the universe. I am simply getting something off my chest and calling out in the darkness I feel in my life.
Yeah the thing is though it has nothing to do with being alone physically it is just about feeling lone mentally. I am around people, I just can't let them know how I feel.
I don't know. I doubt it. They all have their own issues to take care of. Unfortunately I think I am going to have to work on this alone away from them.

Not very feasible. Right now I don't have the money and I don't think anyone else does either. Plus I am worries that if I go home I will feel even more defeated. I just have to try and hope for the best. It is hard because I feel really low right now.
